title: Mupi weUchenjeri Husingaperi
intro: Munhu anoremekedzwa, anozivikanwa nekunzwisisa kwake kwakadzama uye mazano ane hungwaru, akambopa mazano asingaperi. Mashoko avo, akanyorwa mumagwaro matsvene, anotungamira vanhu pakutenda, mwoyo murefu, uye maitiro akarurama.
clues: Ndakapa mwana wangu zano pamusoro pechivi chikuru kupfuura zvimwe zvose: kusanganisa Allah nevamwe.
Ndakadzidzisa nezvehuremu hwemabasa, kunyangwe kukosha kwembeu yemasitadhi, uye kuti Allah achazviunza sei.
Ndakasimbisa kutenda Allah nevabereki, ndichibvuma matambudziko ekurera mwana.
Zano rangu raisanganisira kusimbisa munamato, kuraira zvakanaka, kurambidza zvakaipa, uye kutsungirira nemoyo murefu zvinowira munhu.
Chitsauko chiri muKorani chakanyorwa zita rangu, chine dzidziso dzangu nezvidzidzo zvandakagovana.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
